summary_plain_english: The API field 'full_name' was renamed to 'name' on the GET /items/{id} endpoint. Two frontend files are affected: the auto-generated TypeScript types file (types.gen.ts) declares 'full_name' in both UserCreate and UserPublic interfaces, and the Admin table column component (columns.tsx) uses 'full_name' as a table accessor key and reads it directly to render the user's name — both will silently break after the rename.
